subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown, the faces of which are marked with the letters A, B, C, D, E and F. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the face having the letter ‘D’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac961ecd867a1ebf5cdf5b746cb38af25c28dbd882a35bf58c7ba9495c1511a8.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As B is common on both the dice II and III, it is clear that A, C, E, and F are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. D will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/075546828be67c1ce4ddc514a029131800805b3d0b2a392fa7486f8ea1ee6568.png] 

Opposite pairs:

C → E

A → F

B → D

So, the opposite side of "D" will be side "B".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
